decisions.statement: A guard here is a hook the dispatch runs over a tool call.
A call naming no argument reads the past twenty-four hours.
A run is one guard run over one tool call.
The rows are read from beside the page of the guard that ran.
Every guard the dispatch runs is reached through the index rather than a folder named here.
An inference hook is dispatched the same way and is read here too.
Every numbered file of those rows is read rather than the first alone.
The phase a row spells is the harness event name rather than a phase of akasha's own.
The events read are the events the guard pages name.
A row naming a test run beside the same page counts nowhere here.
The runs are gathered under the guard that ran.
The seconds recorded are the dispatcher's child seconds and so the guard's.
The peak is the dispatcher's own mark rather than the guard's.
A file that would not read is named rather than counting as no runs.
A row a write left half appended is passed over and the rest of the file read.
A guard holding no run of what was chosen is not listed at all.
The total counts the distinct runs read rather than the records read.
The total shares the processor time over the distinct runs read.
The total draws its average memory as `-`.
A run that noted no high-water mark is left out of the memory reported.
Guards are ordered by what their runs took on average.
Guards taking equal processor time are ordered by name.
A run writes no value the commit has.
Nothing here runs a guard.
An argument this command does not take is refused.

definition: the command saying what a guard over a tool call cost in processor time and memory
